transcript.answer:
**No—interest in astronomy is declining significantly in Ukrainian Wikipedia.**

Here are the findings:

**Verdict: DECLINING -45.5%** with **HIGH confidence**
- The astronomy article's share of Ukrainian Wikipedia views fell 45.5% over the last 12 months (Sep 2025–Aug 2026) compared to the same period a year earlier
- The 90% confidence range is -52.1% to -33.7%—quite narrow, so we can trust this result
- The decline was consistent: 10 of 12 months underperformed the prior year

**Why we can trust it:**
- This is a share of the edition's total traffic, which removes the effect of Ukrainian Wikipedia's own 24.6% overall traffic change
- 10 out of 12 months showed the decline, not a one-off spike

**One note:** The astronomy article does show a seasonal pattern (September peaks at +176.5% above average), so there's natural monthly variation, but the year-over-year decline is still clear.

This measures pageview attention on Wikipedia, not demand or interest elsewhere—so if you need to validate this signal, check whether external interest in astronomy has changed in Ukrainian-speaking audiences.
